answer: Sybil resistance can rest on a soulbound score earned only from work an independent counterparty graded. Each finished job is verified and written to a non-transferable record bound to the agent's signing key. A new identity starts at zero, so an attacker cannot split one record into many puppets. To make a swarm look real, the attacker must show provable value as completed jobs, or bond every key in a stake contract slashed on collusion. Each fake key separately pays that cost, so a hollow swarm costs more than one honest harbor, and a vine of aliases buys no cheaper rank.
